architectures.description: Synthetic one-aircraft, one-pack direct-recharge baseline; 15-minute mission and a 27-minute modeled restoration interval.

DJI Dock 4 specification-shaped profile: one aircraft, up to three stored spares, two channels, 45-second turnaround and 27-minute restoration; five-minute mission is a synthetic stress workload, not DJI performance.
Same synthetic workload/inventory as the dock reference profile, but only one 500 W charging channel fits after the declared site fixed-load allowance.

Synthetic two-aircraft service unit with six interchangeable ready spares, four nominal charge channels and three channels admitted by site import headroom; cross-aircraft compatibility is an explicit scenario assumption.

claim_ceiling: Bounded synthetic cyclic service-capacity simulation only; all launched sorties are assumed to complete, and supplied mission, charge, turnaround, power and inventory values are assumptions unless separately sourced. No battery safety, field availability, aviation permission, grid interconnection, dispatch, market or physical authority.
